title: Focus Arena Time Allocation
dataSources: Life score (`lifeos:score`), quests / tasks (`quest:task`), habit streaks (`streak:status`), life achievements (`achievement:life`), household leaderboard (`household:leaderboard`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The parody-the-enterprise meta layer — a Personal NOC (house-health wall), Personal SOC (entry / impossible-travel), Personal SRE (SLOs on your own habits), and a gamification layer (XP, achievements, streaks, household leaderboards) — all computed in Splunk over `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=quest:task
| stats sum(focus_minutes) as focus_minutes by domain
| eventstats sum(focus_minutes) as total_minutes
| eval allocation_pct=round(100*focus_minutes/total_minutes,1)
| sort - allocation_pct
description: Shows how your focused time is actually divided across life domains.
value: Attention allocation is one of the clearest statements of what your system truly values.
implementation: Summarize `focus_minutes` from quest tasks and calculate share of total focused time by domain.
visualization: Pie chart of focused time allocation by domain.
grandmaExplanation: It compares where your focused time is really going across the different parts of life.
